reviews.review: This game could seriously use some voice acting added instead of silent text. I hated not being able to do or see much in the beginning loft scene. I admit, I'm not a fan of walking sims in general, but there are some really good ones out there that are exceptions. This, however, is definitely not one of them. At one point I waited 10 minutes after looking all around and clicking on everything thinking something would eventually happen before trying YET AGAIN to look all around and it finally triggered the story to progress. I'm glad so many people like it as all developers need to start somewhere, but this just was not for me. I think I would absolutely love this game if two things were to change: 1) add voice acting to go along with the text dialogue and 2) add more to the ending. It finally gets interesting and then it's suddenly over, cut off, roll credits. The game has so much promise, it deserves a better ending.
